# CV6 -- does the per-family corpus effect replicate at 1.4B and 2.8B?

**GENERATED by `tools/make_cv6_description.py`; do not edit by hand.** Every number is read from a results file and the key it came from is named. ZERO ANALYSIS, per `../HOW_TO_READ_THIS.md`: this document records what was run and what came out, never what it means.

## WHAT WAS RUN

For each of `pythia-1.4b-deduped` and `pythia-2.8b-deduped`: the eval battery's activations `h_t` were cached once on the fitting device at the fitting dtype, at each item's own readout position on the **stripped** prompt, over the five admitted eval sets -- 801 scorable (item, intermediate) pairs in all (multihop 103, multilingual 394, order-ops 110, poetry 98, typo 96). Then **15 operators** were fitted -- five in-stream corpora x three disjoint seed blocks, N=25 prompts each -- and every operator was scored against that one cache, together with the unfitted identity (`logit_I`) arm. Each operator was additionally re-scored through an fp16 round-trip, recorded as a diagnostic. No number here is pooled across families.

## PRE-REGISTERED RULE (verbatim)

From `docs/experiments/preregs/CV6_per_family_ladder.md`, stored in the results file at `decision_rule_verbatim`:

> Evaluated PER FAMILY; the verdict is the count across the five.
> REPLICATES if R(f,2.8B) >= 10 on >= 4 of 5 families AND ordering tau >= 0.6 on >= 3 of 5.
> ATTENUATES if R(f,2.8B) < 5 on >= 4 of 5 families.
> UNCLEAR otherwise, including a split where some families replicate and others do not — a split is an informative outcome, not a failure.
> Do not pool to force a verdict.
> Do not add models to chase a threshold.
> Do not drop a family.

PRIMARY, stored at `PRIMARY`: `R(f, m) = spread_z(f, m) / pooled_seed_sd_z(f, m)`, the spread taken across the five corpora and the seed SD the RMS of the per-corpus 3-seed sample SDs, **computed within that family**.

## VERDICT STRING AS STORED

`VERDICT` = **"REPLICATES"**

`verdict_note` = "the corpus effect is not an artifact of the low-competence regime at 410M"

## DECLARED BIAS AS STORED (`declared_bias`)

* Capability and scale are confounded; every larger model is also differently trained. No outcome licenses a causal reading — only 'the effect does / does not survive up the ladder'.
* The 5 corpora are a fixed panel, not a sample. n=5 is the replication unit for any claim about KINDS of corpus.
* N=25 here vs N=200 at 410M. S2 established reads are flat in N, so this is expected to be immaterial, but it is a difference and an attenuation must not be attributed to scale without checking N.
* Per-family seed SDs are thin: 3 seeds, 96-394 pairs per family. Thin denominators are what inflated the retired 58x figure. The SD is reported beside every ratio.
* The 410M reference is D3, which is EXPLORATORY and was computed BEFORE this pre-registration. The per-family estimand may not be described as chosen on capability grounds alone.
